title: Residential and Investment Opportunities on the Gunjur Main Road More Information contact 7207201102
description:
We are excited to introduce you to our Gunjur Project, a residential development that offers high-quality 2BHK, 3BHK+2T, and 3BHK+3T apartments. Spanning across approximately 5 acres, this project aims to provide a comfortable and modern living experience with over 30 amenities. We would like to inform you that we are currently in the process of obtaining necessary approvals from the Bangalore Development Authority (BDA) and will comply with the guidelines set by the Real Estate Regulatory Authority (RERA) for a transparent and secure investment.

Project Overview:

Location: Gunjur Main Road.
Total Land Area: Approximately 5 acres.
Total Towers: 3 towers, each consisting of around 24 stories.
Amenities: Over 30 amenities are planned to enhance your lifestyle within the project.

2BHK Apartments:
Size: Between 1340 to 1350 square feet

3BHK+2T Apartments:
Size: Between 1680 to 1690 square feet

3BHK+3T Apartments:
Size: Between 1980 to 1990 square feet

Please Note: Floor rise charges will be additional from the 4th floor onwards.

We are committed to ensuring the highest standards of construction quality and providing you with a comfortable and luxurious living environment. The Gunjur Project offers meticulously designed apartments with spacious floor plans, modern amenities, and a strategic location near educational institutions and other essential facilities.

Please note that we are in the process of obtaining approvals from the Bangalore Development Authority (BDA) and will adhere to the guidelines set by the Real Estate Regulatory Authority (RERA) to ensure a transparent and secure investment for our customers.

To express your interest in the Gunjur Project and stay updated with the latest developments, kindly provide us with your contact information. Our sales team will keep you informed and guide you through the booking process once we have received the necessary approvals.

Thank you for considering our Gunjur Project for your residential investment. We appreciate your patience during the approval process and assure you that we are dedicated to providing you with a premium living experience.
